name: sanyu-research-mcp
description: Medical research engines (106 deterministic tools + 39 AI writers): ROC/AUC with DeLong CI, survival KM/Cox, Table 1, sample size, PSM/IPTW, DEG, GO/KEGG enrichment, PPI network, primer design, literature search. Every response carries engine_status (real/unavailable/error) and data_source — auditable, not LLM guessing. Failed calls are never charged, and 3 tools (sequence translate, ORF, ROC) run key-free for evaluation. Official Chinese name: 三域医研 · 科研算法引擎 (SanYu Research Engine).
